newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: OFT SAYS TO AUCTION CZK 654.25MLN FIN MIN BONDS.
newsitem.headline: OFT SAYS TO AUCTION CZK 654.25MLN FIN MIN BONDS.

text.p: OFT Brokers, manager of the Czech Finance Ministry's state bond auction, said on Friday it would hold an auction next Monday of 654.25 million crowns worth of five-year state bonds held over from an auction in 1996.
The bonds bear a 10.95 fixed coupon, and their minimum price will be announced later on Friday, OFT said in a statement.
The bonds were issued last August but only 1.9 billion worth were actually sold.
OFT said the minimum amount sold would be five million crowns. Price will be the top criterion for evaluating bids, followed by amount.
Auctions will continue every Monday until the whole amount is sold, the statement said.
